ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels in the central and peduncle region to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central dark pigmentation forms a large, continuous anchor-shaped blob extending from the notch to the mid-lobe. High-intensity white fields are located on the outer third of both left and right lobes, with localized grey mottling appearing at the high-contrast transition boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1.2:1.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge. The right lobe (viewer perspective) exhibits a significant jagged indentation and loss of linear continuity mid-edge. The left lobe displays a more consistent but still heavily serrated 'sawtooth' pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary sweep is convex moving from the distal tips toward the notch, with significant micro-deviations caused by edge irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel groups (barnacle attachment points) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, particularly prominent on the right tip with associated yellowish-brown discoloration.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks are visible within the white pixel fields of the left lobe, cutting through the high-intensity background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major trailing edge trauma characterized by irregular tissue loss on the right lobe and frayed, asymmetric terminal ends on both the left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish-yellow bio-fouling or barnacle colonization cluster on the far-right distal tip.
